en: Hand-colored historic street view showing a cobblestone intersection with an obelisk-like monument in the center, surrounded by period buildings. People and children stand and sit around the square, and a horse-drawn carriage approaches from the right. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Penig and a specific street, with publisher information and a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.
